title: South Korea's Adbiotech Acquires 51% Stake in Korean Distribution Unit of Kazakhstan's K-Beauty Platform Bestee - BigGo Finance
text:
South Korea's Adbiotech Acquires 51% Stake in Korean Distribution Unit of Kazakhstan's K-Beauty Platform Bestee — BigGo Finance Ask AI News Markets Earnings Calls Calendar Watchlist Podcasts Influencers Earnings Calls Calendar Watchlist Podcasts Influencers More Ask AI News Watchlist Holdings Markets Earnings Calls Calendar Podcasts Influencers South Korea's Adbiotech Acquires 51% Stake in Korean Distribution Unit of Kazakhstan's K-Beauty Platform Bestee
 Add preferred source 1 South Korea's Adbiotech is acquiring a 51% stake in the Korean distribution subsidiary of Kazakhstan's K-beauty platform Bestee, marking its entry into the Central Asian cosmetics distribution business. The deal follows a strategic business cooperation agreement signed in October and gives Adbiotech management control over the local sales network rather than a simple export contract. Adbiotech will handle brand discovery, product sourcing and exports, while Bestee will manage on-the-ground sales using some 140 influencers and AI-based skin consulting. The Central Asian beauty market is projected to grow from $2.4 billion in 2022 to $3.7 billion in 2027, and the company plans to expand its distribution network into Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan and other neighboring markets. Key Elements 
 Adbiotech Bestee Kazakhstan Central Asia K-beauty Uzbekistan Kyrgyzstan KOTRA KOSDAQ South Korea's KOSDAQ-listed Adbiotech (179530) is making a full-scale entry into the Central Asian cosmetics distribution business by acquiring a 51% stake in the Korean distribution subsidiary of Kazakhstan's K-beauty platform Bestee. The deal is a follow-up to a strategic business cooperation agreement signed in October, and its key significance is that Adbiotech has secured management control of a local sales network rather than merely signing an export contract.
 According to the company on the 19th, the majority stake gives Adbiotech oversight of the entire process — from identifying South Korean cosmetics brands and sourcing products to signing supply contracts and exporting. Bestee will handle actual sales by mobilizing its local distribution network and influencer marketing organization. The two sides split responsibilities: product competitiveness in South Korea and sales capability on the ground.
 Bestee's social media-based sales channels are cited as a differentiator for the business. It works with about 140 local influencers active on Instagram and TikTok, whose combined followers total roughly 45 million. The influencers use South Korean cosmetics themselves, produce reviews and usage tutorials as content, and link that content to online purchases — a strategy that prioritizes purchase conversion over ad impressions.
 An AI-based skin consulting feature is also integrated. It analyzes consumers' skin conditions and lifestyle habits and cross-references data on about 1,800 cosmetic ingredients to recommend personalized skincare products. Because the model uses performance-based marketing in which commissions are tied to sales results, South Korean brands can enter the market with less initial burden.
 Using the acquisition as a foothold, Adbiotech plans to build an integrated distribution value chain spanning brand sourcing, influencer marketing, online sales and consumer data analysis. It also outlined a plan to broaden its product lineup beyond basic and color cosmetics into inner beauty and beauty devices.
 The company will expand its business footprint in stages. It plans to transplant the influencer marketing and online sales model proven in Kazakhstan to neighboring countries such as Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan, and is considering extending distribution into surrounding markets including Russia over the medium to long term. According to KOTRA projections cited by the company, the Central Asian beauty market is expected to grow from about $2.4 billion (approximately 3.2 trillion won) in 2022 to about $3.7 billion (approximately 4.9 trillion won) in 2027.
 Category Details 
 Acquisition target 51% stake in Bestee's Korean distribution subsidiary 
 Preceding transaction Strategic business cooperation announced in October 2026 
 Local influencers About 140, with combined followers of roughly 45 million 
 AI analysis data About 1,800 cosmetic ingredients 
 Central Asian beauty market Projected to grow from $2.4 billion in 2022 to $3.7 billion in 2027 
 Expansion regions Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan, Russia and others under review 
 Note: Market size projections are based on KOTRA data cited by the company.
 Behind the attention on the deal is a shift in the K-beauty export landscape. Expectations for a reopening of the Chinese market are rising after the substantive conclusion of follow-up negotiations on services and investment under the South Korea-China free trade agreement, but South Korean cosmetics companies have simultaneously worked to reduce dependence on any single market. Adbiotech's choice of Central Asia over China can be read in the context of diversifying distribution bases.
 Industry observers say securing management control of a local platform is qualitatively different from a simple export contract, because it allows the company to secure both a stable sales network and consumer data. Still, some caution that whether the deal translates into actual revenue growth will depend on local sales performance.
 Adbiotech is an eco-friendly biotech company that has developed products for livestock, fisheries and human use based on research and development of immune antibodies and specific antibodies. After changing its name in 2001, it moved from KONEX to the KOSDAQ market in January 2022. Recently it has been expanding into bio R&D, medical and healthcare, companion animals and digital platforms through partnerships with digital healthcare companies, laying the groundwork for medium- to long-term growth.
 A company official said, "This acquisition of a stake in the Korean distribution subsidiary is meaningful in that we have secured a powerful distribution platform that directly connects excellent South Korean cosmetics companies with Central Asian consumers." The official added, "By combining our sourcing capabilities with Bestee's influencer and AI technologies, we will generate substantive new revenue and cultivate a global K-beauty distribution business as a new core growth engine."
